items.summary: Recommendation: approve only the bounded SeedstoSauce report and one public read-only positioning/conversion inspection. Reject production, revenue, attribution, telemetry, spending, credential, configuration, and high-priority queue work because site-specific outcomes and attribution are not evidenced, while the queue already contains unresolved failures and pending measurement. Owner decision: should SeedstoSauce remain report-only until site-specific measurement and attribution evidence become available?
